title: Charred Vietnamese Noodle Salad
description: A refreshing and flavorful salad made with charred noodles, wildly foraged vegetables, and a hint of Vietnamese spices.

ingredients.name: charred carrots
ingredients.notes: charred to bring out natural sweetness

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.notes: for a depth of umami flavor

instructions: Char the noodles over an open flame until slightly blackened.
Slice the carrots into thin rounds and char them alongside the noodles.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, charred noodles, and charred carrots.
Sprinkle the chopped cilantro over the top of the salad.
Drizzle the sriracha sauce and fish sauce over the salad, and toss to combine.
